core.name: Busking
core.description: A Bard can take an hour and make a Busking roll in the nearest town center. The total is crowns earned while performing. A fumble lowers income; a negative total means no coin and locals harass the Bard (−2 Charisma in that town for the day).

tiers.name: Return Act
tiers.description: Before Busking, roll Return Act (GM sets DC) to see if the Bard played here before. On success, Busking income doubles and the Bard gains +2 Charisma at that venue.

tiers.name: Raise A Crowd
tiers.description: By performing for a full round, roll Raise A Crowd to captivate anyone within 20 m. Targets who fail Resist Coercion vs. your roll can only watch until they beat it; being attacked snaps them out.

tiers.name: Good Friend
tiers.description: Once per session, roll Good Friend to find an ally. Split the roll between Settlement, Profession, and Importance (see rulebook chart). The friend does one reasonable favor, then must be convinced again.

tiers.name: Fade
tiers.description: Roll Fade vs. multiple targets' Awareness to blend into the background without cover—joining conversation, drawing attention elsewhere, etc. Fails if wearing flashy clothing.

tiers.name: Spread the Word
tiers.description: After a successful Deceit roll, roll Spread the Word vs. the target's Resist Coercion. On success the target spreads your lie through their settlement or group, granting +2 to Deceit when repeating that lie to others.

tiers.name: Acclimatize
tiers.description: In a settlement, roll Acclimatize (DC by settlement size). On success the Bard passes as a local (+2 Charisma & Persuasion with locals, not treated as an outsider).

tiers.name: Poison The Well
tiers.description: Roll vs. target's EMP×3 while influencing people. On success, a pointed comment imposes −1 per point above DC to the target's Seduction, Persuasion, Leadership, Intimidation, or Charisma rolls.

tiers.name: Needling
tiers.description: Roll vs. target's Resist Coercion to goad them with insults until they attack. The target takes a penalty to attack and defense equal to half your Needling value for that many rounds.

tiers.name: Et Tu Brute
tiers.description: Roll vs. target's WILL×3 to turn them against one ally. On success they treat that ally with mistrust for days equal to Et Tu Brute value, until Resist Coercion beats the roll.

core.name: Patch Job
core.description: Take a turn and roll Patch Job at DC = item Crafting DC − 3 to keep gear in the fight: restore broken armor/shield to half SP or a broken weapon to half durability (half damage until properly fixed). An item can only be patched twice total (second patch brings it to ¼ SP/durability).

tiers.name: Extensive Catalogue
tiers.description: Memorize extra weapon/armor diagrams in your head. At capacity, roll DC 15 (+1 per 10 diagrams memorized) to memorize one more—no hard limit.

tiers.name: Journeyman
tiers.description: When crafting, roll Journeyman vs. the item's crafting DC. Success adds +1 DMG or +1 SP per 2 points above DC (max +5). Cannot raise further with Luck.

tiers.name: Master Crafting
tiers.description: Craft master-grade items. Roll Master Crafting vs. crafting DC to permanently grant armor resistance (your choice) or weapons 50% bleeding or −2 Stun.

tiers.name: Mental Pharmacy
tiers.description: Like Extensive Catalogue but for formulae: roll DC 15 (+1 per 10 memorized) to hold one more formula in memory.

tiers.name: Double Dose
tiers.description: When making an alchemical item, roll vs. formula crafting DC. Success creates two units with one set of ingredients (potions, oils, decoctions, bombs).

tiers.name: Adaptation
tiers.description: Before brewing a witcher potion, roll Adaptation (DC 3 + crafting DC) to lower the poisoning avoidance DC by 1 per point over DC (minimum 12). Failure leaves normal toxicity.

tiers.name: Augmentation
tiers.description: Roll vs. Augmentation chart DC to add special bonuses to weapons or armor in 3 rounds. A forge grants +2; a fumble damages the item by the fumble value.

tiers.name: Silver Coating
tiers.description: With a forge and silver ingots (2 for 1-handed, 4 for 2-handed), roll DC 16 to add +1d6 silver damage per 3 points above DC (max 5d6). Failure breaks the weapon.

tiers.name: Pinpoint
tiers.description: Study an item 1 turn and roll Pinpoint vs. its crafting DC to find a design flaw, enabling a −6 targeted attack that deals ablation damage in half your Pinpoint value in d6.

core.name: Practiced Paranoia
core.description: Within 10 m of a trap, ambush, or experimental trap, immediately roll Practiced Paranoia vs. trap DC, ambush Stealth, or GM DC. Even on failure you sense that something is wrong.

tiers.name: Case The Area
tiers.description: Spend an hour in a settlement and roll vs. settlement DC. Success maps guard patterns and hiding spots for +2 Stealth in that area for days equal to your value.

tiers.name: Mental Key
tiers.description: After picking a lock, roll Mental Key vs. its DC to memorize tumblers and reopen without a Pick Lock roll. Store as many as INT; replace freely.

tiers.name: Go To Ground
tiers.description: Once per session, roll and split points across Area, Security, and Perks (rulebook chart) to find a hideout until destroyed; you can always return.

tiers.name: Weak Spot
tiers.description: Roll vs. sentient target's Deceit to learn their most valued possession or person, plus +1 Intimidation per 2 points above their roll until the weak spot changes.

tiers.name: Marked Man
tiers.description: Roll vs. target's EMP×3 to mark them (carved sign, etc.). They need Charisma, Persuasion, or Intimidation beating your roll to get help or services in their settlement.

tiers.name: Rally
tiers.description: Once per day, spend an hour and roll Rally (GM sets DC). Recruit 1 Bandit per 2 points above DC for days equal to Rally; bandits below half HP may flee vs. your WILL on d10.

tiers.name: Careful Aim
tiers.description: When not in active combat, spend a round aiming and roll vs. target REF×3. Next attack gains bonus equal to half Careful Aim; being spotted before attacking halves the bonus.

tiers.name: Eye Gouge
tiers.description: Melee attack at −3 to hit; on hit deals 2d6 and blinds for rounds equal to Eye Gouge value.

tiers.name: Assassin's Strike
tiers.description: When ambushing, roll vs. target Awareness to conceal yourself after the attack. Light and cover impose penalties; each opponent may roll to spot you.

core.name: Healing Hands
core.description: Only a Doctor with Healing Hands can heal critical wounds (multiple successes by severity; DC by severity). Also usable for any First Aid task.

tiers.name: Diagnose
tiers.description: Examine a wounded subject (GM sets DC). Success reveals critical wounds and remaining HP, plus +2 to Healing Hands on those wounds.

tiers.name: Analysis
tiers.description: Before Healing Hands, spend a turn and roll vs. critical wound severity. Each 2 points over DC (min 1) reduces surgery time by 1 turn.

tiers.name: Effective Surgery
tiers.description: Before healing a critical wound, roll vs. its Healing Hands DC. Success doubles healing rate for critical and regular wounds.

tiers.name: Healing Tent
tiers.description: Roll vs. GM DC to create a covered medical space in 1 hour: +3 Healing Hands/First Aid inside and +2 healing rate for occupants for days equal to your value.

tiers.name: Improvisation
tiers.description: Roll vs. crafting DC of a medical alchemical to substitute on-hand materials (1 round, retry on failure). Works only for that specific injury.

tiers.name: Herbal Remedy
tiers.description: Mix substances into a remedy (see rulebook chart) in 1 turn; lasts 3 days, one use by burning or chewing.

tiers.name: Bleeding Wound
tiers.description: With a bladed weapon, roll DC 15 after dealing damage. Success causes bleeding at 1 HP per 2 points over DC until stopped by First Aid vs. your roll.

tiers.name: Practical Carnage
tiers.description: Roll vs. opponent BODY×3 to make their wounds and critical wounds heal half as fast (countered by Effective Surgery and healing-rate boosts).

tiers.name: Crippling Wound
tiers.description: Attack at −6; on success imposes REF, BODY, or SPD penalty of 1 per 3 points above defense. Removed only by Effective Surgery beating your attack roll.

core.name: Magic Training
core.description: Roll when encountering magical phenomena, unknown spells, or theory (GM sets DC). Success recalls full knowledge. Also works like Awareness for detecting magic, spells, and hexes.

tiers.name: Scheming
tiers.description: Roll vs. target INT×3. Success grants +3 to Deceit, Seduction, Intimidation, or Persuasion vs. that target for days equal to Scheming value.

tiers.name: Grape Vine
tiers.description: Spend 1 hour and roll vs. target EMP×3 to spread rumors, lowering their local reputation by half your Grape Vine value for that many days.

tiers.name: Assets
tiers.description: Once per game, roll and split points across Settlement, Profession, Importance, and Relationship (rulebook chart) to recall a helpful contact.

tiers.name: Reverse Engineer
tiers.description: Study an alchemical solution 1 hour; roll vs. crafting DC + 3. Success writes a formula that is +3 harder to craft but reliable.

tiers.name: Distillation
tiers.description: Use instead of Alchemy when brewing. Success creates a dose with 50% stronger effect (duration, damage, or resistance DC—your choice, round down).

tiers.name: Mutate
tiers.description: Spend all STA and a full day; roll vs. (28 − (BODY+WILL)/2). Success grants a minor mutagen effect; failure puts subject in Death State with the major mutation.

tiers.name: In Touch
tiers.description: Each point grants +2 Vigor threshold (trainable). At level 10, maximum Vigor threshold becomes 25.

tiers.name: Immutable
tiers.description: Roll DC 16 when affected by dimeritium. Success retains half Vigor threshold and can still cast, though still uncomfortable.

tiers.name: Expanded Magic
tiers.description: Before casting a spell or ritual, roll DC 16. Success lets you channel through any 2 foci, reducing Vigor cost twice.

core.name: Tough As Nails
core.description: At 0 or below HP, roll vs. (negative HP × 2) to keep fighting at Wound Threshold. Failure enters Death State. Further damage forces another roll based on current HP.

tiers.name: Extreme Range
tiers.description: On ranged attacks beyond normal range, roll vs. distance DC to ignore range penalties (targeting/environment penalties remain).

tiers.name: Twin Shot
tiers.description: Replace normal ranged skill; on hit, two projectiles strike two random body locations. Can be dodged as one action or blocked by a shield; parry at −6.

tiers.name: Pin Point Aim
tiers.description: After a ranged critical, roll vs. target DEX×3. Success adds Pin Point Aim value to the critical location roll only.

tiers.name: Bloodhound
tiers.description: Add Bloodhound to Wilderness Survival when tracking. If the trail is lost, roll Bloodhound (GM DC) to pick it up immediately.

tiers.name: Booby Trap
tiers.description: Set one trap type (rulebook table) with 2 m tripwire; spotting requires Awareness vs. your Booby Trap roll.

tiers.name: Tactical Awareness
tiers.description: Instead of moving, roll to gain +3 attack/defense vs. enemies within 10 m whose DEX×3 is below your roll for 1 round, and learn their intended actions.

tiers.name: Fury
tiers.description: Roll vs. EMP×3. Success grants immunity to fear, emotion magic, and Verbal Combat for Fury×2 rounds; rage clouds thinking.

tiers.name: Zweihand
tiers.description: Spend 10 STA; roll Zweihand−3 vs. defense for one double-damage armor-piercing attack (upgrades existing piercing traits per rulebook).

tiers.name: Shrug It Off
tiers.description: BODY times per session, spend 10 STA when an enemy scores a critical on you. Beat their attack roll to negate the critical and take normal damage only.

core.name: Well Traveled
core.description: Roll when you need a fact about an item, culture, or area (GM sets DC). Success recalls the answer from past travels.

tiers.name: Options
tiers.description: Roll vs. GM DC to find the same item at half price (higher rarity = higher DC). Does not apply to experimental, witcher, or relic items.

tiers.name: Hard Bargain
tiers.description: When bribing, roll vs. WILL×3 to use any 5-crown item for +3 Persuasion (+5 DC for absurd bribes).

tiers.name: Promise
tiers.description: When buying, roll vs. salesperson EMP×3 to pay later; they wait weeks equal to Promise value.

tiers.name: Rookery
tiers.description: Roll vs. settlement DC to gain 1 urchin/vagrant per point over DC (max 10) for +1 Streetwise each; pay 1 crown per consult.

tiers.name: Insider
tiers.description: Spend 10 crowns and roll vs. Resist Coercion to recruit a spy for days equal to Insider (may re-roll and re-pay).

tiers.name: Treasure Map
tiers.description: Once per session, roll vs. GM DC to recall a relic or ruin location—usually dangerous and quest-worthy.

tiers.name: Well Connected
tiers.description: On entering a settlement, spend an hour spreading word then roll vs. settlement DC. Raise local reputation by half points over DC (min 1) for 1d6 weeks.

tiers.name: Fence
tiers.description: Roll vs. GM DC to sell dubious/stolen goods at full market price to a no-questions buyer.

tiers.name: Warrior's Debt
tiers.description: Roll and split points on the Warrior chart (rulebook) to call a fighter who works for days equal to Warrior's Debt without questioning reasonable orders.

core.name: Initiate of the Gods
core.description: At same-faith churches (GM DC) gain free lodging, healing, and services. Works with lay faithful too, but they offer less. Ineffective on other faiths.

tiers.name: Divine Power
tiers.description: Each level adds +1 Vigor threshold (trainable, stacks with Nature Attunement). At level 10, threshold totals 12 from this path.

tiers.name: Divine Authority
tiers.description: Add full value to Leadership where your religion is worshipped; half value elsewhere.

tiers.name: Precognition
tiers.description: When GM sends visions (3 rounds catatonic), roll vs. GM DC to interpret symbolic future visions.

tiers.name: Nature Attunement
tiers.description: Each level +1 Vigor threshold (trainable, stacks with Divine Power). At level 10, threshold totals 12 from this path.

tiers.name: Read Nature
tiers.description: In natural environments, roll vs. GM DC to learn what passed through and what they did—localized, cannot track.

tiers.name: Animal Compact
tiers.description: Add to Wilderness Survival with animals. Spend a round to ally one beast for hours equal to value (monsters unaffected).

tiers.name: Blood Rituals
tiers.description: When casting a ritual, roll vs. casting DC to replace missing alchemical components with 5 HP blood each (can be others', spilled during the ritual).

tiers.name: Fervor
tiers.description: Roll vs. target INT×3 to grant 1d6 temp HP per point over DC (max 5) for Fervor×2 rounds; once per target per day.

tiers.name: Word of God
tiers.description: Roll vs. Resist Coercion to gain apostles (max = value; use bandit stats). Strange orders need Word of God vs. GM DC—3 failures lose them (fumble may turn them hostile).

core.name: Witcher Training
core.description: In hostile terrain, reduce penalties by half Witcher Training (min 1). Substitutes for Monster Lore. Covers monster knowledge and adaptability from years in the keep.

tiers.name: Meditation
tiers.description: Trance grants sleep benefits while remaining vigilant; considered awake for noticing threats within double Meditation value in meters.

tiers.name: Magical Source
tiers.description: Every 2 points grant +1 Vigor threshold (trainable). At level 10, max Vigor threshold is 7 from this ability.

tiers.name: Heliotrope
tiers.description: When targeted by spell/invocation/hex, roll Spell Casting vs. opponent and spend half their Vigor cost to negate.

tiers.name: Iron Stomach
tiers.description: +5% max toxicity per 2 points (trainable). At level 10, max toxicity is 150%.

tiers.name: Frenzy
tiers.description: While poisoned, +1d6 melee per Frenzy level; must reach safety or kill poisoner. End early with DC 15 Endurance.

tiers.name: Transmutation
tiers.description: When taking a decoction, roll DC 18. Success grants the decoction's mutation bonus (rulebook table) at half normal duration.

tiers.name: Parry Arrows
tiers.description: Deflect projectiles like melee parries (not non-physical magic). AoE attacks detonate after the parry.

tiers.name: Quick Strike
tiers.description: After your turn, spend 5 STA and roll vs. opponent REF×3 for an extra strike that round (disarms/trips allowed).

tiers.name: Whirl
tiers.description: Spend 5 STA/round to attack everyone in sword range each turn using Whirl as the attack roll; can only whirl, dodge, and move 2 m until hit or you act otherwise.
